description: This file defines the Git::SVN::Migration package with functions for migrating and managing SVN layout versions within a Git repository, including layout migration routines and configuration adjustments.

classes.name: Git::SVN::Migration
classes.description: Module providing routines for migrating SVN layouts and managing SVN remotes within Git repositories.

methods.name: migrate_from_v0
methods.description: Migrates repositories from layout version 0 to a newer layout by renaming refs and updating URLs.

methods.name: migrate_from_v1
methods.description: Migrates repositories from layout version 1, copying data from old SVN directories to new structure.

methods.name: migrate_from_v2
methods.description: Migrates repositories from layout version 2 by reading old URLs and initializing new SVN remotes.

methods.name: minimize_connections
methods.description: Optimizes SVN remote connections by consolidating URLs and updating configuration.

methods.name: migration_check
methods.description: Performs sequential migration checks and optional connection minimization.
